g.text: Differential expression, PD vs GM — C3 (CD8 TEM (ZEB2-hi))
n = 17 samples (10 GM / 7 PD); 2183 genes after filtering. TMM-normalised.
Dashed lines: |log2FC| = 1. Colour = BH-adjusted significance; y-axis = unadjusted p.
Immunoglobulin genes excluded (ambient, donor-driven). Yellow outlined: genes of interest, labelled regardless of significance.
